title: Accelerated Execution of Bayesian Neural Networks using a Single Probabilistic Forward Pass and Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2511.23440v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine learning models perform well across domains such as diagnostics, weather forecasting, NLP, and autonomous driving, but their limited uncertainty handling restricts use in safety-critical settings. Traditional neural networks often fail to detect out-of-domain (OOD) data and may output confident yet incorrect predictions. Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) address this by providing probabilistic estimates, but incur high computational cost because predictions require sampling weight distributions and multiple forward passes. The Probabilistic Forward Pass (PFP) offers a highly efficient approximation to Stochastic Variational Inference (SVI) by assuming Gaussian-distributed weights and activations, enabling fully analytic uncertainty propagation and replacing sampling with a single deterministic forward pass. We present an end-to-end pipeline for training, compiling, optimizing, and deploying PFP-based BNNs on embedded ARM CPUs.

translated_title: 使用单次概率前向传播与代码生成加速贝叶斯神经网络的执行
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型在诊断、天气预报、自然语言处理和自动驾驶等领域表现良好，但其有限的不确定性处理能力限制了在安全关键场景中的应用。传统神经网络往往无法检测分布外（OOD）数据，并可能输出看似自信却错误的预测。贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）通过提供概率估计解决了这一问题，但由于预测需要对权重分布进行采样并进行多次前向传播，计算成本很高。概率前向传播（PFP）通过假设权重和激活服从高斯分布，为随机变分推断（SVI）提供了一种高效的近似方法，实现了完全解析的不确定性传播，并用单次确定性前向传播取代了采样。我们提出了一个端到端流水线，用于在嵌入式ARM CPU上训练、编译、优化和部署基于PFP的贝叶斯神经网络。
tldr: 该论文通过假设权重和激活服从高斯分布，用单次解析式的概率前向传播取代多次采样前向传播来加速贝叶斯神经网络，并构建了在嵌入式ARM CPU上训练、编译、优化和部署的端到端流水线。
en_tdlr: This paper accelerates Bayesian neural networks by replacing multiple sampling-based forward passes with a single analytic Probabilistic Forward Pass (PFP) that assumes Gaussian-distributed weights and activations, and presents an end-to-end pipeline for training, compiling, optimizing, and deploying PFP-based BNNs on embedded ARM CPUs.
